title: Yet Another ClickFix Campaign, (Wed, Oct 28th)
description: A ClickFix campaign was observed on October 28, 2026, using a fake Cloudflare verification page to target macOS and Windows users. The campaign attempts to distribute malware but was unsuccessful due to server errors and domain resolution failures. Indicators include multiple URLs from the domain js-static.cfd hosting the fake verification page. No malware samples were obtained, and the campaign's full impact remains unclear.
